item.title: The Perforce Driver You Never Knew You Had: Composer CVE-2026-40261 and CVE-2026-40176
item.description: Two command injection vulnerabilities in Composer’s Perforce driver are exploitable even if you’ve never touched Perforce. For Magento shops running dev dependencies from source, CVE-2026-40261 is a supply-chain exposure hiding behind a feature most teams don’t know is active.

item.title: Three Signals from November: What the Bulletins Don't Say
item.description: The November 2025 bulletin wave included a CVSS 9.1 session takeover, a stored XSS in Magento-lts, and an active Xurum webshell campaign. Read together, they describe something the individual advisories don’t.
